title: v18: Studio's flow text slots insert and prescribe `{{ }}` (the objectui half of objectstack-ai/objectstack#22110)
body:
Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#22110

Filed by the triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015, `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`) as the foreseen objectui half of objectstack-ai/objectstack#22110. ⛔ Not a claim.

The unlock keys on the install face. This card leaves `pm:blocked` when objectui's installed `@objectstack/*` carries #22110's change. That is the v18 line, and objectui stays on `^17` until GA.

Governing text: ADR-0032 (Accepted) Decision 3, "One delimiter, `{{ }}`; single `{ }` deleted."

## What Studio does today (read on objectui `main` `9990f9e122`)

- `text` / `textarea` flow node fields are treated as single-brace `{var}` templates (`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/flow-node-config.ts:334`–`340`).
- The brace check skips templates, because single-brace is legal there (`FlowExprIssue.tsx:7` and `:65`; `FlowNodeConfigField.tsx:481`).
- Placeholders and help text teach `{var}`: `flow-node-config.ts:600`, `:763` and `:1102`, and the zh help strings at `views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts:6287` and `:6300`.
- `VariableTextInput.tsx` inserts variable tokens into these fields.

## Direction (once #22110 lands)

- In the slots #22110 converts, and only those (its step 1 enumerates them), inserted tokens, placeholders and help text use `{{ x }}`.
- The template check flags single-brace in those slots and offers the `{{ }}` fix.
- ⛔ CEL roles keep their brace-in-CEL check unchanged.

`Clause-②: no`. Changeset per the objectui release line at that time.

Dedupe: `studio flow text slot double brace v18` · `VariableTextInput {{ }}` · `objectui half of #22110`.
